about: tune.py's draft group: the prompts of the trace that FNX_DRAFT_STOP_ISO's tables are fit on (tune/stop_iso_fit.py). None of them is in bench/bench.py, which measures the result. 300 tokens each, at every sampling below.
prompts: Explain in about 200 words how a heat pump heats a house in winter, for someone without a physics background.
Write a polite email to a landlord asking to fix a leaking kitchen tap, mentioning it has been dripping for two weeks.
Compare PostgreSQL and SQLite for a small web app with about 50 users. Give the trade-offs as a short list.
Summarize the causes of the 2008 financial crisis in five bullet points.
Write a bash script that finds the 10 largest files under a directory given as its first argument and prints their sizes.
A train leaves at 9:40 and travels 210 km at 84 km/h, then stops for 12 minutes, then travels 95 km at 76 km/h. When does it arrive? Show the steps.
Write a short story (about 250 words) about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.
What are the main differences between TCP and UDP? When would you choose each?
Give me a 3-day itinerary for a first visit to Kyoto, with one paragraph per day.
Explain what a Kubernetes Deployment, a Service and an Ingress are, and how they work together.
Write a SQL query that returns, for each customer, their total order amount in 2024 and their rank by that amount.
Razloži v približno 200 besedah, kako deluje toplotna črpalka zrak-voda in zakaj je pozimi manj učinkovita.
Napiši vljudno elektronsko sporočilo sosedu, v katerem ga prosiš, naj ob večerih nekoliko utiša glasbo.
Primerjaj prednosti in slabosti električnega avtomobila in avtomobila na bencin za voznika, ki na leto prevozi 15.000 km.
Povzemi glavne vzroke prve svetovne vojne v petih alinejah.
Napiši kratko zgodbo (približno 200 besed) o dečku, ki v gozdu najde izgubljenega psa.
Kako spečem domač kruh brez kvasa? Opiši postopek po korakih.
Pojasni razliko med nominalno in efektivno obrestno mero pri posojilu in dodaj preprost primer.
Napiši funkcijo v Pythonu, ki prešteje, kolikokrat se v besedilu pojavi vsaka beseda, in vrne deset najpogostejših.
Kaj so glavne značilnosti parlamentarne demokracije? Odgovori v enem odstavku.
Predlagaj tridnevni izlet po Primorski za družino z otroki, z enim odstavkom za vsak dan.
Razloži, kaj je strojno učenje, tako da bo razumel dvanajstletnik.
Popravi slovnične napake v tem besedilu in pojasni popravke: 'Včeraj sem šel v trgovino in kupil sem kruha, mleko in dve jabolki ker sem bil lačen.'
Write a Python function that checks whether a string is a valid IPv4 address, with a few tests.
Write a Python function merge_intervals(intervals) that merges overlapping intervals and returns them sorted.
Write a JavaScript function that debounces another function by a given number of milliseconds.
Write a Python class LRUCache with get and put in O(1) time.
Write a C function that reverses a singly linked list in place.
Write a Python function that parses one CSV line whose quoted fields may contain commas and escaped quotes.
Write a Rust function that returns the n-th Fibonacci number by iteration, using u128.
Write a SQL query that returns the second highest salary from an employees table, or NULL if there is none.
Write a Python function that computes the Levenshtein distance between two strings.
Write a bash pipeline that prints the 5 most common words in a text file, ignoring case.
Write a Go function that reads a file line by line and counts the lines that are not empty.
Write a Python function that checks whether a 9x9 sudoku board (a list of lists, 0 for empty) breaks any rule.
